symptom: Para merge-worker 以 devfleet/cursor/sub-1-327c02: diff-too-large:50140 否决 PR；自维护修复轮次仍把 FHD/XCAGI/kb/fixes 与 modstore_server 生产改动合在同一分支，使 three-dot diff 持续超过 30000 字符预算。
root_cause: diff-too-large 门禁只拒绝 auxiliary-only 变更，未在 open_item 仍为 diff-too-large 时禁止 KB 路径进入 auto-merge，也未从 veto detail 解析 review_diff_chars 供循环记忆与提示使用。
fix_diff:
diff --git a/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_policy.py b/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_policy.py
--- a/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_policy.py
+++ b/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_policy.py
@@ -83,6 +83,32 @@ def para_merge_review_max_diff_chars() -> int:
         return 30000
 
 
+def parse_merge_review_diff_char_count(detail: str) -> Optional[int]:
+    match = re.search(r"diff-too-large:(\d+)", str(detail or ""), re.IGNORECASE)
+    return int(match.group(1)) if match else None
+
+
+def memory_has_diff_too_large_remediation(memory: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:
+    ...
+
 diff --git a/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_loop_runner.py b/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_loop_runner.py
--- a/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_loop_runner.py
+++ b/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_loop_runner.py
@@ -4465,6 +4465,20 @@ def _assess_branch_auto_merge_policy(
+        if requirement.get("required") and memory_has_diff_too_large_remediation(memory):
+            kb_paths = [f for f in normalized_files if f.startswith("FHD/XCAGI/kb/")]
+            if kb_paths:
+                return _decision({"ok": False, "reason": "kb_paths_blocked_during_diff_too_large_remediation", ...})

executable_template.applicability_check: Open automated_remediation item has review_veto_code diff-too-large and branch diff still includes FHD/XCAGI/kb paths while modstore_server changes are present.
executable_template.patch_strategy: Add parse_merge_review_diff_char_count and memory_has_diff_too_large_remediation; persist review_diff_chars on reconcile; block auto-merge with kb_paths_blocked_during_diff_too_large_remediation when KB paths appear during active diff-too-large remediation.
executable_template.rollback_plan: Revert KB-path block in _assess_branch_auto_merge_policy and remove parse_merge_review_diff_char_count / memory_has_diff_too_large_remediation exports.
